description: Split marking a message as read out of sendMessage. POST /{phone_number_id}/messages takes either a message or `{ status: "read", message_id, typing_indicator? }`, and the spec types both under one SendMessageResponse (messaging_product, contacts and messages required). A mark-read answers `{ "success": true }` instead: observed live on 2026-11-17 on an inbound message, with and without typing_indicator, and again on the same message. One operation per body keeps each response typed: sendMessage takes WhatsappMessage and returns SendMessageResponse; markMessageAsRead takes MarkReadRequest's members and returns `{ success }`. An unknown message id fails with Graph code 131009 (400).

traits.smithy.api#documentation:
Mark a message as read

Marks an inbound message, and the ones before it in the conversation, as read. With `typing_indicator: { type: "text" }` the user also sees a typing indicator until you reply or about 25 seconds pass. Marking a message that is already read succeeds again.
